about.text: A Swedish goat cheese with a camembert-type white-mould rind, developed in the 1970s at Ramsele Getgård in Västernorrland from local fäbod goat cheese. It is pressed as a hard cheese, brine-salted, then surface-inoculated with camembert mould and ripened two to twelve months.

sources.text: Its milk, process, ripening and origin.
